ads.text: Telugu: 'ప్రతి నెల పెరుగుతున్న కరెంట్ బిల్లులకు ఇక గుడ్‌బై! మీ ఇంటిపై సోలార୍ పానెల్స్ ఏర్పాటు చేసుకుని పొందం: ✅ ₹78,000 వరకు ప్రభుత్వ సబ్సిడీ / ✅ ₹22,000 వరకు Vanguard ప్రత్యేక ஆଫର୍* / ✅ 100% వరకు ఫైనాన్స్ సౌకర్యం. ఈ ஆଫର୍ పరిమిత కాలం మాత్రమే. ఇప్పుడే కాల్ చేసి ఉచిత సైట్ విజిట్ & కోట్ పొందం.' - limited-period offer with a free site visit and quote.

ad_library.summary: Vanguard Energy is running 1 active Telugu Meta ad (Facebook), started 9 October 2026. The ad stacks up to Rs. 78,000 government subsidy, a Rs. 22,000 Vanguard offer and up to 100% finance, and pushes a free site visit and quote. The click lands on an fb.me link inside Facebook, so the spend never reaches vanguardenergy.in. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every click opens a Facebook surface, not vanguardenergy.in. You own no pixel on the landing experience, you cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not enquire, and there is no page you can test a different headline or price on. With a single ad live there is also no second creative angle to learn from.

findings: The one live ad points to an fb.me link inside Facebook - the click never lands on vanguardenergy.in, so no pixel, no retargeting pool, no testable landing page.

The ad's promise (Rs. 78,000 subsidy + Rs. 22,000 offer + up to 100% finance) is fully substantiated on the site - TGREDCO-empanelled supplier, on-grid rooftop EPC, net metering and solar-loan pages - but the paid traffic never sees any of that proof.
Two domains are live (vanguardenergy.in and vanguardenergysystems.com) with two inboxes (info@ and a Gmail address) - a split identity that can send the same enquiry to two places or none.
1 ad, live since 9 Oct, all cold traffic. There is no retargeting ad behind it and no second creative to test the finance angle against the subsidy angle.
The '100% finance' promise is the sharpest hook in the ad - and it is only measurable if the click lands on a page you own.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own
Point the ad at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page carrying the same Rs. 78,000 + Rs. 22,000 + 100% finance offer, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not enquire - usually 10-20x the people who fill a form.
Settle on one domain and one inbox
Publish vanguardenergy.in and info@vanguardenergysystems.com everywhere (ads, forms, footer) so an enquiry can never sit unread or land on the wrong domain.
Give the finance angle somewhere to land
A simple EMI/loan section on the landing page turns the '100% finance' hook into a form fill instead of a dead-end fb.me click.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: Only 2 offer angle in live copy (subsidy amount, free site visit) - every ad says the same thing.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Oct 9, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Facebook lead form (fb.me).

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
